newsitem.title: USA: EDITEK test gets FDA pre-market clearance.
newsitem.headline: EDITEK test gets FDA pre-market clearance.

text.p: EDITEK Inc said on Tuesday that it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration pre-market clearance for its new EZ-Screen Profile product, which tests for drugs of abuse on-site.

This product allows the customer to test for the five most commonly requested drugs of abuse -- cannabinoids or marijuana, cocaine, opiates, amphetamines and PCP -- on a single device about the size of a credit card, EDITEK said, adding that the test yielded results in less than 10 minutes.

"The clearance of the EZ-Screen Profile product now allows us to aggressively market the product to the non-federally mandated industrial market segment," said Michael Terretti, EDITEK vice president and general manager.

The drug testing market was comprised of two major segments -- the federally mandated segment, primarily made up of the Department of Transportation, and the non-federally mandated or voluntary segment.
Terretti said the voluntary market segment represented about 75 percent of the total analytical testing market.
"Industrial clients will now be able to make important employment decisions in a matter of minutes with EZ-Screen Profile," he said.
The company said it was too early to comment on the product's potential market value.
